snippet.title: Pokemon Go as a Game Boy game!
snippet.description:
Pokemon Go would have been possible as a Game Boy game! This is a sample of what it might have looked like. Play it for yourself!

Interested in seeing how it was created? Check out this video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nr4jPbfoRZM

Play it yourself! Works as a browser game or a Rom download:
https://healthpotionstudios.itch.io/pokemon-go-game-boy

Subscribe to the channel  for more videos like this!

===========================================

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513000/Vicious_Vine/
